title: Apply for approval as secretary of a registered club
summary: You can apply online to Liquor & Gaming NSW for approval to act as a secretary for a registered club.
intro:
A registered club must have an approved secretary (who's also the Chief Executive Officer).

If you have the necessary authorisation, you can apply for approval from Liquor & Gaming NSW, online.
who_can_apply: Have Responsible Service of Alcohol (RSA) qualification
Have Advanced Responsible Conduct of Gambling (ARCG) qualification (if the club operates gaming machines)
Have completed the mandatory training course Board Governance, the Company Secretary and the General Manager
what_you_need: Liquor licence name and number of the club
Your past employment history details as a club secretary or liquor licensed approved manager
Your RSA and ARCG competency card number and details, or copies of the RSA and ARCG certificates
National Police Check certificate issued within the last 3 months
Copies of the 3 identity documents used to apply for the National Police Check

how_to_steps.text: Enter your liquor licence number (including the letters) and your name.

more_info.text: When lodging online, ensure all the documents you attach are in PDF format.

faqs.q: Who needs to be approved as a secretary?
faqs.a: A registered club must have an approved secretary, who must also be the Chief Executive Officer.

faqs.q: What qualifications are required to apply?
faqs.a: You must be 18 or older, have a Responsible Service of Alcohol (RSA) qualification, and have completed the mandatory training course Board Governance, the Company Secretary and the General Manager.

faqs.q: Do I need special qualifications if the club operates gaming machines?
faqs.a: Yes, if the club operates gaming machines, you must also have an Advanced Responsible Conduct of Gambling (ARCG) qualification.
